description: Delete a calendar event. IRREVERSIBLE: fails unless confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true. Deletion cannot be undone.

occurrence.description: For a recurring event: which occurrence, as the occurrenceDate from calendar_events (every occurrence shares one id). Required to edit or delete one unless span is 'all'.

span.description: For a recurring event: 'this' occurrence (default), this and 'future' ones (both need occurrence), or 'all' for the whole series.
